title: Frequency Response Data
description: Output from FrequencyAnalyzer methods (calculateSPL and calculateSystemResponse)

spl.description: Sound Pressure Level values in dB (may include -Infinity for muted or no signal)

phase.description: Phase values in degrees, normalized to -180 to +180 range

speakerResponses.description: Individual speaker responses keyed by component ID (only present in calculateSystemResponse output)

spl.description: SPL values in dB for this speaker

phase.description: Phase values in degrees for this speaker
